ios.desc:
Take pictures, make puzzles, and stump your friends! FuzzWord is a new way to share and play with all the photos you take. Create private puzzles between a close group of friends or make a public puzzle for anyone to play.

Play user submitted photos to gain points, and move up the leaderboards. Solve fast to gain the maximum points and coin bonuses. 

Stuck? Drop a couple FuzzBombs to reveal part of the picture. You may also delete letters from the letter bank or reveal a correct letter. 

Like a photo? You can tap the heart button to follow other users and receive their public puzzles in your inbox.

Leaderboards are based on total points and total hearts. Can you make it to the top?
